manifest.name: stage-a-vps-full-apt-upgrade
manifest.purpose: Full non-interactive apt-get upgrade on Ubuntu 24.04 (noble-security, noble-updates, third-party sury-PHP). Holds a literal exclude list with apt-mark hold and releases it at the end (also on error, via EXIT trap with the same literal list). Passes dpkg config options in apt syntax (--force-confdef/--force-confold) to both 'install needrestart' and 'upgrade'. No reboot, no dist-upgrade, no new kernel, no docker commands. Records package versions to /var/tmp/cockpit-stageA before and after.

steps.name: record-versions-and-update
steps.run:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export NEEDRESTART_MODE=l
mkdir -p /var/tmp/cockpit-stageA
dpkg-query -W > /var/tmp/cockpit-stageA/packages-before.txt
apt-get update

steps.name: hold-upgrade-unhold
steps.run:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
export NEEDRESTART_MODE=l
apt-mark hold gitlab-ee gitlab-runner gitlab-runner-helper-images docker-ce docker-ce-cli docker-ce-rootless-extras docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin containerd.io linux-generic linux-image-generic linux-headers-generic linux-firmware linux-libc-dev linux-tools-common
trap 'apt-mark unhold gitlab-ee gitlab-runner gitlab-runner-helper-images docker-ce docker-ce-cli docker-ce-rootless-extras docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin containerd.io linux-generic linux-image-generic linux-headers-generic linux-firmware linux-libc-dev linux-tools-common' EXIT
apt-get -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold install needrestart
apt-get -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold upgrade
apt-mark unhold gitlab-ee gitlab-runner gitlab-runner-helper-images docker-ce docker-ce-cli docker-ce-rootless-extras docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin containerd.io linux-generic linux-image-generic linux-headers-generic linux-firmware linux-libc-dev linux-tools-common
trap - EXIT
dpkg-query -W > /var/tmp/cockpit-stageA/packages-after.txt

checks.name: services-active
nextcloud-installed-true
checks.run: curl -fsSk --max-time 30 https://nextcloud.wejos.de/status.php | grep -q '"installed":true' || { echo "Nextcloud not installed:true"; exit 1; }

checks.name: unhold-and-report
checks.run:
export NEEDRESTART_MODE=l
if apt-mark showhold | grep -Eq '^(gitlab-ee|gitlab-runner|gitlab-runner-helper-images|docker-ce|docker-ce-cli|docker-ce-rootless-extras|docker-buildx-plugin|docker-compose-plugin|containerd.io|linux-generic|linux-image-generic|linux-headers-generic|linux-firmware|linux-libc-dev|linux-tools-common)$'; then echo "excluded package still held"; exit 1; fi
echo '=== needrestart -b ==='
needrestart -b || true
echo '=== /var/run/reboot-required ==='
if test -f /var/run/reboot-required; then echo 'present'; else echo 'absent'; fi
echo '=== upgraded packages (before -> after) ==='
diff /var/tmp/cockpit-stageA/packages-before.txt /var/tmp/cockpit-stageA/packages-after.txt || true
echo '=== currently held ==='
apt-mark showhold
echo '=== wireguard-ops-cockpit services ==='
systemctl list-units --type=service --all --no-legend 'wireguard-ops-cockpit-*'

rollback: Restore the runner automatic machine snapshot taken before the first step (mutates=true); report the snapshot name in the job result.
Reinstall a previous version for any regressed package using the recorded /var/tmp/cockpit-stageA/packages-before.txt (apt-get install package=version).

manifest.name: stageA-noble-security-update
manifest.purpose: Stage A security update on Ubuntu 24.04 (noble): record pre-upgrade package versions and running Docker containers; apt-mark hold the exceptions (gitlab-ee, gitlab-runner, gitlab-runner-helper-images, docker-ce, docker-ce-cli, docker-ce-rootless-extras, docker-buildx-plugin, docker-compose-plugin, containerd.io, and every installed linux-* kernel package); apt-get update; install needrestart; apt-get upgrade non-interactively with DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive, NEEDRESTART_MODE=l and --force-confdef/--force-confold (list mode, no automatic service restarts beyond those the packages themselves trigger, no reboot); release the holds at the end and on any error via EXIT trap; write state files under /var/tmp/cockpit-security-stageA. The runner's automatic pre-change machine snapshot is the return path (id reported in run output).

steps.name: record-pre-upgrade-state
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
D=/var/tmp/cockpit-security-stageA
mkdir -p "$D"
dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version}\n' > "$D/pre-upgrade-packages.tsv"
docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' > "$D/pre-upgrade-running-containers.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo "pre-upgrade state recorded to $D"

steps.name: hold-exceptions-install-needrestart-and-upgrade
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
D=/var/tmp/cockpit-security-stageA
HOLD_NAMES="gitlab-ee gitlab-runner gitlab-runner-helper-images docker-ce docker-ce-cli docker-ce-rootless-extras docker-buildx-plugin docker-compose-plugin containerd.io"
HOLDS=""
for p in $HOLD_NAMES; do if dpkg-query -W -f='${Status}' "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; then HOLDS="$HOLDS $p"; fi; done
HOLDS="$HOLDS $(dpkg-query -W -f='${Package}\n' 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^linux-' | tr '\n' ' ')"
HOLDS=$(printf '%s\n' $HOLDS | sort -u | sed '/^$/d' | tr '\n' ' ')
release() { if [ -n "$HOLDS" ]; then apt-mark unhold $HOLDS >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; }
trap release EXIT
if [ -n "$HOLDS" ]; then apt-mark hold $HOLDS; printf '%s\n' $HOLDS > "$D/held-exceptions.txt"; fi
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=l apt-get -y update
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=l apt-get -y install needrestart
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive NEEDRESTART_MODE=l apt-get -y -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confdef -o Dpkg::Options::=--force-confold upgrade
release
trap - EXIT
echo "security upgrade complete; holds released"

steps.name: record-post-state-and-report
steps.run:
set +e
D=/var/tmp/cockpit-security-stageA
dpkg-query -W -f='${binary:Package} ${Version}\n' > "$D/post-upgrade-packages.tsv"
echo '=== UPGRADED PACKAGES ==='
join -1 1 -2 1 <(sort "$D/pre-upgrade-packages.tsv") <(sort "$D/post-upgrade-packages.tsv") 2>/dev/null | awk '$2!=$3{print $1": "$2" -> "$3}'
echo '=== NEWLY INSTALLED PACKAGES ==='
comm -13 <(awk '{print $1}' "$D/pre-upgrade-packages.tsv" | sort) <(awk '{print $1}' "$D/post-upgrade-packages.tsv" | sort) | sed 's/^/NEW: /'
echo '=== REMAINING UPGRADABLE (open) ==='
apt-mark showhold 2>/dev/null || true
DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -s upgrade 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^Inst ' || true
echo '=== HELD EXCEPTIONS THIS RUN ==='
cat "$D/held-exceptions.txt" 2>/dev/null || true
echo '=== REBOOT REQUIRED ==='
if [ -f /var/run/reboot-required ]; then echo "yes: $(cat /var/run/reboot-required)"; else echo "no"; fi
echo '=== NEEDRESTART ==='
needrestart -b 2>&1 || true
exit 0

checks.name: cockpit-services-active
checks.run:
for u in wireguard-ops-cockpit-agent wireguard-ops-cockpit-api wireguard-ops-cockpit-web wireguard-ops-cockpit-ttyd wireguard-ops-cockpit-executor; do systemctl is-active --quiet "$u.service" || { echo "cockpit service not active: $u"; exit 1; }; done
if systemctl list-units --type=service --state=failed --no-legend 'wireguard-ops-cockpit-*' 2>/dev/null | grep -q .; then echo "failed cockpit units present"; exit 1; fi

checks.name: docker-containers-still-running

rollback: Revert the runner's pre-change machine snapshot (id reported in the run output): operator-approved full-machine restore that discards everything written since the snapshot.

Downgrade changed packages to the recorded versions in /var/tmp/cockpit-security-stageA/pre-upgrade-packages.tsv via apt-get install <pkg>=<version> where the archive still holds them; restore prior conffiles from the borg backup if a package changed one.
If the run was interrupted leaving holds set: apt-mark unhold every name listed in /var/tmp/cockpit-security-stageA/held-exceptions.txt.

manifest.name: hermes-umschalten-probe-tuer-trocken-20261010-trocken
manifest.purpose: James (Hermes-Gateway, Container 'hermes') von hermes-agent:neu-20261008 (sha256:de128fcf15df) auf hermes-agent:neu-20261008 (sha256:de128fcf15df) umschalten. Anlass: Probe der Tuer (t_69165977): trocken, dasselbe Abbild. TROCKENLAUF: das Skript setzt TROCKEN=1 und endet nach den Vorbedingungen mit exit 0, bevor es etwas sichert oder aendert; es liest nur (sha256, docker image/container inspect, hermes kanban list) und schreibt nur Pruefmaterial nach /run. Pruefmaterial im Schritt: Abnahme aus der Werkstatt (abnahme.json, gruen fuer genau NEU_ID). Skript = hermes-deployment@f9587dff479c (sha256 und cmp vor dem Start).

steps.name: umschalten (trocken)
steps.run:
install -d -m 0700 /run/hermes-umschalten-probe-tuer-trocken-20261010
cat > /run/hermes-umschalten-probe-tuer-trocken-20261010/umschalten.sh <<'UMSCHALTEN_EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# hermes-umschalten (Cockpit-Tuer), Begruendung: hermes-deployment host/tuer/LIESMICH.md
set -uo pipefail
ANLASS=probe-tuer-trocken-20261010
NEU=hermes-agent:neu-20261008
NEU_ID=sha256:de128fcf15df17d39dbc6a60833b8efc104d5eff36a40589d7877f3f35c9d6eb
ALT=hermes-agent:neu-20261008
ALT_ID=sha256:de128fcf15df17d39dbc6a60833b8efc104d5eff36a40589d7877f3f35c9d6eb
TROCKEN=1
H=/home/hermes/.hermes
DEP=$H/hermes-deployment
V=/var/backups/hermes-umschalten
SICHER=$V/$ANLASS
K=$H/backups/umschalten-$ANLASS
A=/run/hermes-umschalten-$ANLASS
P=$A/protokoll.txt
LOG=$H/logs/agent.log
ELOG=$H/logs/errors.log
U="--reuid=1007 --regid=1007 --clear-groups"
zaehlen() { VORHER=$(timeout -k 5 20 setpriv $U wc -l $LOG | cut -d" " -f1 || echo 999999999); VORHER_E=$(timeout -k 5 20 setpriv $U wc -l $ELOG | cut -d" " -f1 || echo 999999999); }
neu() { timeout -k 5 20 setpriv $U tail -n +"$((VORHER + 1))" $LOG | head -c 16M; }
neue() { timeout -k 5 20 setpriv $U tail -n +"$((VORHER_E + 1))" $ELOG | head -c 16M; }
heil() { test ! -L $H/home -a ! -L $H/hermes-compose.env; }
C_NEU="\"Image\": \"$NEU_ID\""
C_ALT="\"Image\": \"$ALT_ID\""
install -d -m 0700 $A
: > $P
echo "Umschalten $ANLASS: $NEU -- Rueckweg $ALT, trocken=$TROCKEN" | tee -a $P
cat > $A/abnahme.json <<'ABNAHME_EOF'
{"version": "hermes-umschalt-abnahme/v1", "image_id": "sha256:de128fcf15df17d39dbc6a60833b8efc104d5eff36a40589d7877f3f35c9d6eb", "ergebnis": "GRUEN", "beleg": "hermes-deployment ops/chat-verfuegbar-20261008 (94a5b6c)", "datum": "2026-10-10", "hinweis": "Probe der Tuer: dasselbe Abbild", "pruefungen": [{"name": "abnahme-20261008 nachreichen/bewertung", "ergebnis": "GRUEN"}, {"name": "abnahme-20261008-rueckfall", "ergebnis": "GRUEN"}, {"name": "Umschaltlauf 15/15", "ergebnis": "GRUEN"}], "quelle": "Werkstatt-Abnahme neu-20261008 (t_b95d0c60, Zweitpruefung t_1b832d61), Umschaltlauf 10.10. 07:02 15/15"}
ABNAHME_EOF
grep -F "{\"version\": \"hermes-umschalt-abnahme/v1\", \"image_id\": \"$NEU_ID\", \"ergebnis\": \"GRUEN\"," $A/abnahme.json >/dev/null \
  || { echo "Abbruch: Abnahme nicht gruen fuer $NEU_ID"; exit 1; }
test -L $H/config.yaml -o -e $SICHER -o -L $SICHER -o -e $K -o -L $K && { echo "Abbruch: Symlink/Sicherung da"; exit 1; }
test "$(timeout -k 10 60 docker image ls -q --no-trunc $ALT)" = "$ALT_ID" || { echo "Abbruch: Rueckweg $ALT ist nicht $ALT_ID"; exit 1; }
if test $TROCKEN = 0 || timeout -k 10 60 docker image inspect $NEU >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  test "$(timeout -k 10 60 docker image ls -q --no-trunc $NEU)" = "$NEU_ID" || { echo "Abbruch: $NEU ist nicht $NEU_ID"; exit 1; }
fi
timeout -k 10 60 docker inspect --type container hermes > $A/c.json
grep -qF "$C_ALT" $A/c.json || { echo "Abbruch: laufender Container ist nicht $ALT_ID"; exit 1; }
git -c safe.directory=$DEP -C $DEP show 7951e9a16cae8e26bdf8a62030802920ef7b830b:docker-compose.yml > $A/compose.yml
timeout -k 10 120 docker compose -f $A/compose.yml --project-directory $DEP up --dry-run --no-deps -d gateway > $A/probe.txt 2>&1
grep -qE 'Container hermes +Running' $A/probe.txt && test "$(grep -ciE 'creat|start|pull' $A/probe.txt)" = 0 || { echo "Abbruch: compose.yml ist nicht die des Containers"; cat $A/probe.txt; exit 1; }
laufend=1
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  timeout -k 10 20 docker exec -u hermes -e HERMES_HOME=/opt/data -w /tmp hermes /opt/hermes/bin/hermes kanban list > $A/karten.txt \
    || { echo "Abbruch: Kartenliste nicht lesbar"; exit 1; }
  laufend=$(grep -c " running " $A/karten.txt || true)
  if test $TROCKEN = 1; then echo "laufende Karten jetzt: $laufend"; laufend=0; fi
  test $laufend = 0 && break
  echo "warte: $laufend Karte(n) laufen, Versuch $i von 30"; sleep 30
done
test $laufend = 0 || { echo "Abbruch: es laufen noch Karten"; exit 1; }
if test $TROCKEN = 1; then echo "TROCKENLAUF FERTIG, nichts veraendert (UMSCHALT_ERGEBNIS=trocken-ok)"; exit 0; fi

install -d -m 0700 $V && mkdir -m 0700 $SICHER || { echo "Abbruch: Sicherung $SICHER"; exit 1; }
cp $A/c.json $SICHER/container-hermes.json
timeout -k 5 20 setpriv $U head -c 1M $H/config.yaml > $SICHER/config.yaml
setpriv $U mkdir -p $K
grep " scheduled " $A/karten.txt | setpriv $U tee $K/geplant-vorher.txt >/dev/null
test -s $SICHER/container-hermes.json && test -s $SICHER/config.yaml && test -f $K/geplant-vorher.txt || { echo "Abbruch: Sicherung unvollstaendig"; exit 1; }
zaehlen
ablegen() { cp $P $SICHER/; setpriv $U tee $K/protokoll.txt < $P >/dev/null; }
zurueck() {
  trap '' HUP INT TERM PIPE
  echo "RUECKFALL: $1" | tee -a $P
  timeout -k 10 60 docker tag $ALT hermes-agent:latest
  timeout -k 10 120 docker stop -t 30 hermes >/dev/null 2>&1
  timeout -k 5 20 setpriv $U tee $H/config.yaml < $SICHER/config.yaml >/dev/null
  timeout -k 5 20 setpriv $U cat $H/config.yaml | cmp -s - $SICHER/config.yaml && KF= || KF=" config.yaml nicht zurueck,"
  zaehlen
  heil && timeout -k 10 300 docker compose -f $A/compose.yml --project-directory $DEP up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gateway \
    || { echo "Hand-Rueckweg: $SICHER, Snapshot der Tuer (UMSCHALT_ERGEBNIS=rueckfall-gescheitert)" | tee -a $P; ablegen; exit 2; }
  for i in $(seq 1 36); do
    timeout -k 10 10 docker inspect --type container hermes > $A/c.json
    { neu; neue; } > $A/r.log
    if test -z "$KF" && grep -qF "$C_ALT" $A/c.json && grep -q "menschen: Rechteprüfung" $A/r.log && grep -q "Connected to Telegram" $A/r.log; then
      echo "alter Stand laeuft (UMSCHALT_ERGEBNIS=rueckfall-ok)" | tee -a $P
      ablegen; exit 1
    fi
    sleep 5
  done
  echo "Hand-Rueckweg:$KF $SICHER, Snapshot der Tuer (UMSCHALT_ERGEBNIS=rueckfall-unvollstaendig)" | tee -a $P; ablegen; exit 2
}
trap 'zurueck "Signal"' HUP INT TERM
timeout -k 10 120 docker stop -t 60 hermes >/dev/null || zurueck "stop"
timeout -k 10 60 docker tag $NEU hermes-agent:latest || zurueck "tag"
heil || zurueck "Symlink an home/env"
timeout -k 10 300 docker compose -f $A/compose.yml --project-directory $DEP up -d --no-deps --force-recreate gateway || zurueck "compose"
for i in $(seq 1 60); do neu > $A/neu.log; grep -q "zwischenstand: Takt angemeldet" $A/neu.log && break; sleep 5; done
sleep 15
fehler=0
ok() { echo "OK   $1" | tee -a $P; }
fehl() { echo "FEHL $1" | tee -a $P; fehler=$((fehler + 1)); }
timeout -k 10 30 docker inspect --type container hermes > $A/c.json
if grep -qF "$C_NEU" $A/c.json; then ok "Abbild"; else fehl "Abbild"; fi
if grep -q docker.sock $A/c.json; then fehl "Docker-Socket"; else ok "kein Docker-Socket"; fi
if timeout -k 10 30 docker exec hermes /command/s6-svstat /run/service/gateway-default | grep "^up" >/dev/null; then ok "s6"; else fehl "s6"; fi
if timeout -k 10 30 docker exec hermes sh -c "cd /tmp && claude --version" >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok "Claude-CLI"; else fehl "Claude-CLI"; fi
neu > $A/neu.log
for pl in "menschen: Rechteprüfung" "grenzen:" "dienste: 2 Werkzeuge" "zerleger: Bedarfs" "zwischenstand: Takt angemeldet"; do
  if grep -qF "$pl" $A/neu.log; then ok "Plugin $pl"; else fehl "Plugin $pl"; fi
done
t=0
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  { neu; neue; } > $A/neu.log
  if grep -q "Connected to Telegram" $A/neu.log; then t=1; break; fi
  sleep 5
done
if test $t = 1; then ok "Telegram"; else fehl "Telegram"; fi
if timeout -k 10 60 docker exec -i -u hermes -w /tmp hermes /opt/hermes/.venv/bin/python - <<'PYEOF'

s = socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX); s.settimeout(30); s.connect("/opt/data/supervisor/supervisor.sock")
s.sendall(b'{"aktion": "liste"}\n'); r = b""
while not r.endswith(b"\n"): r += s.recv(65536)

PYEOF
then ok "Supervisor"; else fehl "Supervisor"; fi
if timeout -k 10 60 docker exec -u hermes hermes docker --context werkstatt ps >/dev/null 2>&1; then ok "Werkstatt"; else fehl "Werkstatt"; fi
timeout -k 10 320 docker exec -u hermes -e HERMES_HOME=/opt/data -e HERMES_SESSION_PLATFORM=telegram -e HERMES_SESSION_USER_ID=1000000001 -e HERMES_SESSION_USER_NAME=Operator -w /tmp hermes timeout 300 /opt/hermes/bin/hermes chat -Q --oneshot -q "Umschaltprobe: Antworte nur mit dem Wort BIRKENHOLZ." > $A/chat.txt 2>/dev/null || true

neu > $A/neu.log
if grep "Hermes tools bridged" $A/neu.log | tail -1 | grep haus_suche >/dev/null; then ok "Bruecke"; else fehl "Bruecke"; fi
if timeout -k 10 90 docker exec -i -u hermes -e HERMES_HOME=/opt/data -w /tmp hermes /opt/hermes/.venv/bin/python - <<'PYEOF'
from hermes_cli.plugins import discover_plugins; discover_plugins()

PYEOF
then ok "Hilfsaufruf Claude"; else fehl "Hilfsaufruf Claude"; fi
test $fehler = 0 || zurueck "Pruefung(en) rot"
trap - HUP INT TERM
echo "$NEU laeuft, alle Pruefungen gruen (UMSCHALT_ERGEBNIS=umgeschaltet)" | tee -a $P
ablegen

git -c safe.directory=/home/hermes/.hermes/hermes-deployment -C /home/hermes/.hermes/hermes-deployment show f9587dff479cc5676e7efa93bd2605eec22d38b3:ops/probe-tuer-trocken-20261010/tuer/umschalten.sh > /run/hermes-umschalten-probe-tuer-trocken-20261010/aus-commit.sh
